items.quote: I would like to express my sincere appreciation for Elinor from Wavelength, who provided exceptional support throughout my Internal Medicine Specialist application with the RACP. From the very beginning, she guided me through every step of the process from compiling the necessary documentation, reviewing my application, to helping me prepare for the interview. Elinor was incredibly supportive, responsive, and patient throughout the entire journey. Her professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care made what could have been a stressful process much smoother and more manageable. I truly appreciate all her efforts and guidance. Thank you, Elinor, for your dedication and outstanding support. I couldn’t have done it without you!
items.name: Fahad Sheikh

items.quote: I had a wonderful experience working with Elinor Faulkner from Wavelength Recruitment. She has been incredibly supportive and professional throughout my application process for the Royal College of Pathologists of Australasia (RCPA) in the Microbiology discipline. Elinor guided me step by step, made sure all my documentation was complete, and consistently followed up to ensure the process went smoothly. Even though I’m still awaiting my final results, I truly appreciate her patience, clear communication, and dedication in helping me navigate each stage. I would highly recommend Elinor and the Wavelength team to any international doctor seeking guidance with their medical registration or specialist assessment in Australia. Her professionalism and genuine care make a real difference.
items.name: Rahila Khan

items.quote: I had a fantastic experience with Wavelength International, especially with Elinor, who supported me through my medical licence transfer and Australian visa application. The whole process was made so much easier thanks to their straightforward guidance, excellent communication, and genuine willingness to help. Elinor was always quick to respond and kept everything on track. I couldn’t have asked for a smoother experience. Highly recommend to any doctors considering the move to Australia!
items.name: Dan Hunt

items.quote: I had an outstanding experience with Wavelength, thanks to the exceptional support from Elinor. Elinor guided me through the entire process of my RANZCO application with remarkable professionalism and expertise. She was patient, responsive, and ensured every step was clear and seamless. Her dedication made all the difference, and I couldn’t be happier with the service provided. Highly recommend Wavelength for anyone seeking top-notch assistance!
items.name: Gulmeen Raza

items.quote: We are thrilled to share that our Australian Employer Nomination Scheme (Subclass 186 Direct Entry) has been successfully granted through Wavelength International! A huge thank you to the entire team, especially our wonderful agent, Alexandra, who guided us through the entire process. Despite the time difference, as she’s based in Europe, she was always approachable and made sure to address all our questions. We truly appreciate the team’s dedication and support. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you so much!
items.name: Keith Perez

items.quote: It’s my first time to be handled by a migration agent. Miss Alexandra Graham is very accommodating, approachable and very efficient in her work. I just submitted the needed documents to Alex and she handled everything. Got my visa in two weeks.
items.name: Estrellita Tanig

items.quote: My husband and I had an exceptional experience working with Elinor Faulkner from Wavelength. She was an incredible support in helping us obtain our RACP provisional registration, going above and beyond at every step of this long process. Elinor consistently provided expert and honest advice, thoughtful suggestions, and meticulous editing, while encouraging us even when we encountered unexpected obstacles. We cannot thank Elinor enough for her professionalism and dedication, and we would confidently recommend her services to any doctor seeking to apply for Australian registration. Now that we have completed the process, we can clearly say that it would have been far more challenging to obtain our College registration without Elinor’s constant guidance and support.
